import html # Example template – in real use this should be defined elsewhere BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def show_blog_post(headline: str, text: str) -> str: """ Return a sanitized and formatted blog post ready for safe display. Parameters ---------- headline : str The heading of the blog post. text : str The main text content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the escaped title and body inserted into BLOG_FORMAT. """ # Ensure inputs are strings if headline is None: headline = "" if text is None: text = "" # Escape user input to prevent XSS (CWE-79) safe_title = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(text, quote=True) # Format the post using the predefined template formatted_post = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body) return formatted_post
